thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/chat/completions (route: chat-large, region: us-west-2). current p99=2.9s > alert threshold 2.5s. paging oncall@sre :rotating_light:

simon: ack. I'm on it. any customer-facing errors?

maya: seeing increased 503s upstream for a handful of sessions, but frontend retries masking most for new requests. looks like long tail tokens on a few conversations.

alex: grabbing traces now. looks correlated with longer seq lengths + model fallback churn when smaller shards timed out.

julia: marking customer-impact low for now (errors ~0.6% of calls) but latency visible on dashboards. logging incident tag `latency/spike/chat-large`

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0452, severity: P2. Assigned: simon. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0452

simon: live mitigation idea: temp route policy to prefer chat-medium for routes with seq_len>1024 and enable KV cache warmup. can we patch routing quickly?

maya: we can add a per-route override in routing-table for 10m. I'll prepare PR.

alex: alternative: reduce max_batch_size on chat-large pool from 32->16 to cut tail queueing. cheaper to change than routing, but throughput hit.

tony: if we do both (prefer smaller model for long seq + smaller batch), we should see p99 back under 2s within 5-10m. recommend ops + infra change.

simon: ok do both. maya: PR for routing table override, alex: enact batch-size change on pool. coordinate on this thread.

maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/routing/patches/828 - adds rule: when route=chat-large AND avg_seq_len>900 -> prefer chat-medium variant (cost-tier fallback) for 10m. cc @sre

alex: batch size change applied to chat-large pool (rollback in 30m window) `kubectl apply -f /manifests/chat-large-batch-patch.yaml`

alex: patch log:
```
- name: chat-large
  max_batch_size: 32
+ name: chat-large
  max_batch_size: 16
```

julia: monitoring p95/p99 now. dashboards show p95 stable, p99 dropping from 2.9s -> 1.8s after changes. 503s down to 0.2%. nice.

simon: great. leaving mitigation for 20m then start rollback to normal configs if stable. we should follow up with alert tuning: current p99 threshold 2.5s is noisy for chat-large given seq length variance.

tony: agree. propose two changes for post-incident:
1) move p99 threshold to 2.8s for chat-large, p95 stay at 800ms.
2) add a 5m stable-window/hysteresis so alert only fires if p99>threshold for >=5m AND delta>20% compared to baseline.

maya: also request a small per-route dashboard tile that shows model-variant splits + seq_len distribution so signals are actionable. right now we only see aggregated latency which hides shifting seq_len skews.

alex: +1 on hysteresis. we should also add a check to exclude traffic with `is_internal_test=true` from alerting to avoid flakiness.

julia: wrote draft alert rule (please review):
```
alert: ChatLargeP99High
expr: increase(percentile_over_time(latency_seconds{route="/v1/chat/completions",variant="chat-large"}, 0.99[1m]), 0m) > 0
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "chat-large p99 > 2.8s for 5m"
  description: "p99 latency for chat-large is {{ $value }}s; consider routing fallback or capacity scale-up. exclude internal_test traffic."
```

simon: tweak: use `percentile_over_time(..., 5m)` in expr and compare to baseline rolling 1h median to detect relative regressions. add label `route=chat-large` and `model=chat-large` for routing dashboards.

tony: can someone spin up a small dashboard mock? suggested panels: p95, p99, median, seq_len pct95, model-variant %split, 503 rate, active-conns. one-row compact for oncall.

maya: I'll open a grafana ticket and attach draft queries. ticket: https://grafana.redwood/issue/6823 - includes panel JSON and notes.

alex: also adding runbook note to incident playbook: when p99>threshold and seq_len_pct95>900 -> prefer model-variant fallback instead of immediate pager if customer impact <1%.

julia: we should schedule a 30m postmortem to validate thresholds and dashboard effectiveness. propose tomorrow 10:00 PT.

simon: agreed. for now we keep mitigations for another 15m then start rollback. thanks all :thumbsup:
